name: 03 莫伯资本 1+3 四端合成发布

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'your-chat-model', temperature: 0.3, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.system }, { role: 'user', content: $json.user } ] }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO capital.capital_publications (
  slug, category, title, summary, web_markdown, wechat_html,
  xueqiu_markdown, x_thread_json, publish_status, visibility
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'PUBLIC')
ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
  web_markdown = EXCLUDED.web_markdown,
  wechat_html = EXCLUDED.wechat_html,
  xueqiu_markdown = EXCLUDED.xueqiu_markdown,
  x_thread_json = EXCLUDED.x_thread_json,
  publish_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW',
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, slug, publish_status;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ articles: [ { title: $json.title, author: '莫伯 | MoBoCapital', digest: $json.title, content: $json.wechat_html, content_source_url: 'https://mobocapital.com/memo/' + $json.slug, thumb_media_id: $env.WECHAT_DEFAULT_THUMB_MEDIA_ID, need_open_comment: 1, only_fans_can_comment: 0 } ] }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE capital.capital_publications
SET publish_status = 'PUBLISHED',
    wechat_draft_media_id = $2,
    x_root_tweet_id = $3,
    published_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE slug = $1
RETURNING slug, publish_status;

parameters.content:
## 03 1+3 四端合成发布（模板）

- 阶段一：Webhook 合成 → 拉思源母本 → 单次 LLM 合成 → 解析 JSON → 写库 `PENDING_REVIEW`（**绝不直接 PUBLISHED**）。
- 阶段二：Webhook 发布 → 准备载荷 → 微信草稿箱 → X 链式串推 → 回写 `PUBLISHED`。
- 提示词资产：`workflows/prompts/mobo-capital-synthesis-prompt.md`（境内版本强制脱敏 + 免责声明）。
- 微信：需 `WECHAT_ACCESS_TOKEN` 与封面 `thumb_media_id`；只推**草稿箱**，最终群发由人工在公众号后台确认。
- X：需配置 `twitterOAuth2Api` 凭证；未配置时保持「X链式串推」节点禁用。
- 备案与合规：见 `docs/06-合规与成本/证券与自媒体合规.md`。
